messages:
Maya: Quick thread — planning a community refapp launch focused on a \"micro-benchmark\" for inference cost. Metrics target: 250 signups + 60 engaged runs in week 1.
Jun: timeline idea: repo + blog release Tue, short tutorial Wed, live 30m workshop Thu. Reminder social on Wed morning.
Rhea: funneling: HubSpot list = 'oss_microbench_launch'. Hidden fields: utm_variant, repo_action. If someone stars/forks within 5 days -> mark as 'high_intent' and ping #sdr-inbound.
Owen: bench narrative for landing: 1) problem statement (small apps can't afford unpredictable token spend), 2) concrete levers (batching, cache, quant), 3) reproducible single-command bench showing RPS + token-cost. Hero stat: \"Save up to 3x token cost on convo workloads (typical: 1.8-3.0x).\"
Maya: nice. Keep hero conservative and show confidence intervals. We'll A/B test metric-first vs workflow-first headlines.
Jun: devrel-bot: can you seed repo template + bench.sh that outputs JSON with rps, median_latency_ms, token_cost_usd?
devrel-bot: seeded repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/microbench-refapp. bench.sh produces bench_summary.json. CI runs smoke test on PR.
Rhea: HubSpot wiring: form fields = name, work_email, company, role, allow_marketing. Hidden: utm_source, utm_variant, repo_action. Workflow: on submit -> list add + if repo_action present -> set property 'engaged_via_repo' = true.
Owen: landing copy short checklist: 1) 3-step quickstart, 2) bench script, 3) sample prompts, 4) one-pager. Social: X thread (3 tweets) + LinkedIn single post.
Maya: post-webinar followup: recording + 1-pager + 1-click run-in-cloud sandbox link. Survey: biggest pain (latency/cost/quality) -> map to HubSpot property.
Jun: routing rules: EU registrants -> EU SDR, company_size>1000 -> AE queue, sandbox_run -> flag as 'sandbox_engaged'.
Rhea: CRM webhook example we can fire from GH actions on star/fork: ```json
{\"event\":\"repo_signal\",\"action\":\"star|fork\",\"repo\":\"microbench-refapp\",\"utm_variant\":\"A\"}
```
Owen: owners: Jun (landing + socials), Rhea (HubSpot + routing), Owen (bench + demo), Maya (overall). Deliverables due: PRs + landing copy by Tue noon; HubSpot wiring by Wed AM; slides + demo by Wed EOD.
Maya: perfect. Keep messages metric-led and reproducible. Ping if blocked. :rocket:
